notes.title: [Major Bug Fix] Steam Deck Input issues solved
notes.content:
A major bug that caused the input to lag on Steam Deck or Linux + Proton [b]while playing with a joypad[/b] has finally been fixed. Thank you for your patience and massive thanks to everyone who helped fixing it!

[h2]Long version[/h2]

[h3]The bug[/h3]
Several users reported input lag spikes after playing through the game's story or tutorial mode on Steam Deck. The issue only happened when playing with a joypad and only on Steam Deck or Linux + Proton (albeit more rarely), while Windows was completely unaffected.

[h3]The cause[/h3]
Back in 2016, I edited the irrlicht source code to allow for detecting joypads more than once. The original behavior was to keep adding joypads at every new detection, effectively duplicating the list. This was fine at the time because the function to detect joypads was meant to be called [b]only once[/b], when the game started up.

My modification cleared the list of detected joypads before starting a new detection, to solve this issue. Unfortunately, what I didn't do was also [b]releasing the already detected devices[/b], which somehow still lingered in memory, [b]causing the input events to be duplicated or missed entirely[/b] after enough detections had been triggered.

[h3]The solution[/h3]
The solution to this bug was going back to that 2016 code and [b]release all the previously detected devices before clearing the list[/b]. This apparently was the core of the issue.

[h2]Special thanks[/h2]
My thanks go to the members of the community that helped me tackle this nasty bug, since I didn't own a Steam Deck to check it. In no particular order:

[list]
[*] [b]Desaeta[/b], who first reported the bug and helped me find the root cause (see this [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1287800/discussions/0/4343240316590618709/]thread[/url])
[*] [b]Gamingjunkie222[/b] for confirming the bug independently on Twitter, which made things easier to deal with (i.e. showing me it wasn't a bug that just affected one single user)
[*] [b]GamingWarthog[/b] and [b]4C3M4N777[/b], who verified that the fix is indeed working as intended
[/list]

notes.title: Minor update: v.1.6.1 (16.07.2024)
notes.content:
[h1]Schwarzerblitz v.1.6.1 (16.07.2024)[/h1]

[h2]Character changes[/h2]

[h3]Lucia[/h3]
[list]
[*] 9P can now be cancelled on whiff (rationale: Lucia, contrary to most other characters, couldn't cancel any of her moves on whiff. This update gives her at least one whiff cancelable move)
[*] 9P has now Low invul from frame 1
[*] 9P (Supreme) can cancel into 1P
[/list]
   
[h2]Bug fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed bug that persisted since v1.0 that caused some text boxes and menus in Borderless Window mode to appear off-centered
[*] Fixed some older memory leaks that went undetected since v1.0 too
[/list]

[h2]Miscellaneous[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added extra options for switching off joypads and switching off the joypad reconnection check. This might be useful for some bizarre configurations that don't work with the current game and allow the use of software such as Antimicro or Joy2Key in case of need
[/list]

[h2]Note[/h2]
[list]
[*] A bug that affects the game on Steam Deck is still under active scrutiny. See [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1287800/discussions/0/4343240316590618709/]this thread[/url] for more information on the bug and possible workarounds.
[/list]

notes.title: Schwarzerblitz - Candidate v1.6 Release available in the endless-beta branch
notes.content:
[h1]One last huge update[/h1]
Schwarzerblitz v1.6 is coming soon as a last big update... and I need all the player feedback I can get! The release candidate version is available in the [b]endless-beta[/b] branch of the game. To access it:
[list]
[*] Right Click on Schwarzerblitz in your Steam Library
[*] Select [b]Beta[/b]
[*] Input the password [b]mysteryjohnson[/b] to access the endless-beta channel
[*] Switch to the endless-beta channel and let the game update
[/list]
[h2]A new character[/h2]
[b]Lucia Lunarossa[/b], originally released as a Workshop character, will be added to the game in an official form as character #28, to be unlocked by clearing Arcade mode with Mira and Lazor OR Leo and Rattlebone OR Renzo, Mono, Wally and Shaz. She sports an updated and more polished moveset (and, hopefully, more balanced), while still having access to all her transformations

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37436603/218e7b5c03e7272a93a5e3f47fec1f0bf08e91d5.png[/img]

[h2]A new juggle system[/h2]
The juggle system has been revamped to allow for more freeform combos. Every character has now access to a universal launcher that costs one Bullet Counter and a new evasion mechanic called Trigger Escape. A new tutorial section has been added specifically to address this new content.
Each character will also receive [b]a new combo trial[/b] that makes use of the new juggle mechanics.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37436603/6fe258ba2fb8ae5ad6bfa5dee279efc2b257c65b.png[/img]

[h2]Version select[/h2]
You've read it right! All the characters[b] have now access to most of their old movesets[/b], ranging from the very first 2017 Alpha version to the latest update. Version select must be toggled in the options and changes, among other things, how gravity, juggles, mechanics and wake up options behave. If you want a taste of an older Schwarzerblitz version, be sure to check it out!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37436603/3b1f270288a80695a259ed56ca6e9d0c66d0a681.png[/img]

[h2]Unlockable story characters[/h2]
Previously unplayable characters that appeared during the story, such as Army Soldier and Broken Krave, can now be unlocked for Free Match. They can be selected by keeping the Trigger button pressed down while hovering on a certain character.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37436603/1cc3053422247ca0b80ac641c33c2d1048e014fb.png[/img]

[h2]To cry wolf[/h2]
In addition to the above, there is also a new secret arcade boss fight. The conditions to get it are pretty hard, but not impossible if you have already met and beaten Arkaneis in Arcade Mode:
[list]
[*] Don't get any Perfect wins before match #3. If you meet K-069 at any moment during your run, you failed this condition.
[*] Obtain at least 2 Perfect wins after match #3.
[*] Play at Hard or higher.
[*] Win two times or more by Ring Out
[*] Never lose a round nor continue
[*] Defeat Doll in match #6
[*] The new boss will replace Donner as the final arcade boss
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37436603/195140db2353946fd3b9830aba4a06c492e8d768.jpg[/img]

[h2]Quality of life improvements[/h2]
As one last thing, there will be a couple bug fixes and general improvements, such as:
[list]
[*] Replaced some old animations, such as the universal backdash and Kiyoko's run
[*] Improved Record&Replay function in Training Mode
[*] A 3-frames buffer for making links more consistent
[*] A general rebalancing of the cast
[*] Small improvements to the CPU-controlled opponent logic
[/list]

The update will drop within a couple months, so any additional feedback NOW is well appreciated!

notes.title: Schwarzerblitz v1.5 is out! Let the lightning strike LOUDER!
notes.content:
[h2]Schwarzerblitz v1.5 is out![/h2]
Aaaand here you are a full changelog with all what has been modified!

[list]
[*] [b]New feature:[/b] Song selection in Free Match mode is now available
[*] [b]New feature:[/b] Songs which are part of DLC content (such as e.g. the one used in The People's Champ stage) are now available both in the jukebox and as Free Match songs
[*] [b]Adjustment:[/b] the infinite prevention system has been reworked to kick in even when Trigger mode is active. This change is meant to reduce the effect of loops and incentivize Impact Cancels to maximize damage. The IPS will eventually cause a weak knockdown state at the third repetition of the same attack in the current combo, instead of just slashing the hitstun. Moves that require Bullet Counters to be performed  (such as Lazor's Ultimate Diamond Crusher) are not affected by this change. This change might be rolled back later, according to player feedback [[b]NOTE[/b]: this change might make a specific achievement harder to obtain. Investigations are in progress to determine whether this is the case or not]
[*] [b]Adjustment:[/b] pressing Guard during a down sidewalk will go automatically into crouching block instead of requiring a second down input. Conversely, Up sidewalk will not result in an automatic jump when pressing G to avoid unnecessary blunders (current behavior)
[*] [b]Adjustment:[/b] the angle required for Ring Out has been made a little bit more lenient, effectively making ring outs slightly easier to achieve
[*] [b]Training Mode:[/b] Bullet counters are now filled immediately when pressing the reset button
[*] [b]Training Mode:[/b] Evilobster and K-069 have now access to training-mode-exclusive moves to improve the labbing experience
[*] [b]Behavior of computer-controlled opponents:[/b] computer-controlled opponents will jump less randomly when not in range (all AI levels)  
[*] [b]Behavior of computer-controlled opponents:[/b] computer-controlled opponents will try to sidestep projectiles instead of blocking them (level Hard and above). The behavior of Medium and lower AI has not been altered
[*] [b]Characters:[/b] Mono's Cotton Cross (full crouch P+K) has been slightly adjusted to avoid inconsistent behavior
[*] [b]Stages:[/b] Parsec Arena has received a new default song: [b]The Distance (2023 version)[/b]. The previous version of The Distance is still available both in the jukebox and as a selectable song for free match
[*] [b]Workshop/Modding:[/b] added support for character voices that don't overlap and terminate on hit
[*] [b]Workshop/Modding: [/b]fixed issue with how transformations worked, which caused color flashes (e.g. Trigger Guard) not to work properly
[*][b] Bug fix:[/b] fixed bug related to DLC behavior that prevented more than one DLC stage to be available at any given time
[/list]

notes.title: The "Tales from the Epilogue" DLC bundle is now available for purchase!
notes.content:
Finally, the Schwarzerblitz "Tales from the Epilogue" DLC bundle is live and available for purchase!

As a remainder, this DLC pack contains:
[list]
[*] seven short stories, edited and proofread by Kaleb O'Halloran (co-developer of [url=https://gamejolt.com/games/duelsoffortune/714174]Duels of Fortune[/url]), each illustrated by talented artist [url=https://twitter.com/ElizBee5]Eliz[/url] with a full color picture
[*] eight new costumes out of the stories
[*] one new stage with ring out
[/list]
The DLC will be priced around [b]10USD/10€ [/b](scaled as regional prices on Steam), with all proceedings going towards the development of further games.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2198360/Schwarzerblitz__Tales_from_the_Epilogue_Bundle/

Here's the content in detail:

[h1]Digital book with color illustrations[/h1]
A digital book with seven short stories set in the world of Schwarzerblitz, each one provided with a color illustrations by gifted artist Eliz Bee. 

[list]
[*] Tales from the Past — Outback Blues
[*] Tales from Jackson's — Lone Wolf Cub
[*] Tales from Jackson's — Of Mutants and Men
[*] Tales from the Night — A Fleeting Existence
[*] Tales from Jackson's — No Good Deed
[*] Tales from the Ring — The People's Champ
[*] Tales from Crossbones — The Problem with Encorp
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37436603/f5982cc50a2fb35a022a83f58065fbc341d74112.png[/img]
This collection is accessed by browsing the game folder: Right click on Schwarzerblitz in your Steam library > Properties > Browse Local Files. The digital book is available both in ePub and PDF format inside the "extra" folder. Notice that the tales are not provided as additional in-game story chapter!

[h1]Eight brand-new costumes[/h1]
In addition to the digital book, this DLC adds eight new costumes to the game, all based on the short stories. [b]Notice that costumes are simply cosmetic items and don't change the movesets of the affected characters, even when they change the character's name and sound effects.[/b]

[list]
[*] Bartender — costume for Mystery Johnson
[*] Penguin Pajama — costume for Cyphr Wolfchild
[*] Mr. Claws — costume for Evilobster
[*] The Obituary — costume for Evilobster
[*] Chai Constantine — costume for Jenn Husler
[*] Jerediah "Red" Horowitz — costume for Skeleton Skallen
[*] Mao Zereczni — costume for Wally Alba
[*] Gruda Sandweller — costume for Lazor Loyra
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37436603/7b94142da3c855e406063a8d70462249ae828ac1.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37436603/7b99e49ec3b2f59094b020fbf85fa16b6488529e.png[/img]

[h1]One new stage[/h1]
To relive the magic of Evilobster's arcade ending and his epic showdown against The Obituary, a new stage with ring out "The People's Champ - AWA Arena" is now selectable to duke it out like a real wrestler.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37436603/aec279eb5b752762c991a661676f51450c29d4a7.png[/img]

Thanks to all of you who supported the game! I hope you'll have fun reading how the story unfolds and discovering more about the world and characters!

notes.title: Schwarzerblitz v1.4.7 - Minor balance update
notes.content:
[h1]v.1.4.7 - Minor balance update[/h1]

Balance patch to fix a couple legacy characters and remove some unwanted interactions.

[h2]Character adjustments[/h2]

[h3]Kaya [/h3]
[list]
[*] Removed her mid-screen Sukeban Takedown combo, which was completely accidental
[*] Added a Mid and Low option to some of her strings
[/list]

[h3]Krave [/h3]
[list]
[*] Improved frame data on his  2K 2P  string (was negative on hit)
[*] Dab Cancels are now possible from frame 5
[*] Mr. Driller Again's input changed to PPPPP instead of PPP during Mr. Driller to avoid accidental inputs
[*] Spider Stance Cancel ( during Mr. Driller) can be now canceled into forward Spider Step  
[*] Fixed his moveset trial to reflect the above changes
[/list]

[h3]Elena[/h3]
[list]
[*] Her 4K and 1Kattacks have now a Strong reaction and combo into each other. The forward momentum is increased to facilitate the combo
[*] Her c.3K  can be canceled into 8K
[*] Her grab now has Hard Knockdown properties and chains into 2K
[/list]

[h3]Shaz[/h3]
[list]
[*] Improved frame data on 2KKK and 4K to make them safe and not negative on hit
[*] Increased damage on his Impact Headbutt to 30 (followup c.P) 
[/list]

[h3]Lejl[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a missing scaling limiter on her regular grab. Now, when used in a combo, her regular grab will always deal at least 35% of its max damage, independent on the combo scaling
[/list]

[h2]Bug fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Dynamic resolution is switched off by default (caused random crashes on Linux/Proton and Steam Deck)
[*] FPS limit is now 144fps by default, thus avoiding graphic cards going nuclear when the game first launches
[/list]

notes.title: Schwarzerbtlitz v1.3 is out!
notes.content:
[h1]Schwarzerblitz v1.3 is out now![/h1]

After several beta iterations, I'm proud to announce that Schwarzerblitz v1.3 is out! This update brings all the improvements from the endless-beta branch into the main game, including the following major changes:

[h2]New content[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37436603/babb1ae582a4fa6ff99750066822d39f57be84f4.gif[/img]

[list]
[*] [b]New character:[/b] Sir Rattlebone, from Duels of Fortune, joins the battle as a guest character, with one additional costume ("Chez Mick") and his own stage, Kingsland Graveyard!
[*] [b]New character:[/b] Leo Fizeau, the character designed by Berks - who won Schwarzerblitz Indievo2020 - joins the roster as a playable character, with one additional costume ("Super Sentai")!
[*] [b]New stage:[/b] "Kingsland Graveyard", the home stage of Sir Rattlebone!
[*] [b]New stage:[/b] "After Hours", the heart of a closed night club with a hallucinating janitor sharkman who is just imagining the fighters on stage!
[*] [b]New stage:[/b] "Parsec Arena", a homage to [url=https://parsecgaming.com/]Parsec[/url], the middleware we used for running Schwarzerblitz tournaments online!
[*] [b]New trials:[/b] Leo, Rattlebone and Random got their own moveset trials!
[*] [b]New arcade ending:[/b] Random got their own arcade ending!
[*] [b]New costume:[/b] Quarantined Rapport 2 Johnson, as a homage to the QR2 tournament!
[*] [b]New costume:[/b] "Unpaid Bills" janitor Shaz
[*] Additional fan-arts in the game's gallery! 
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37436603/51f96d50bdfb9397878807b7d25ce84abe762905.jpg[/img]

[h2]Bug fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed bug that caused losing due to health bar draining in story mode (during one specific fight) not to trigger a KO sequence.
[*] Fixed a very dangerous bug that caused the AI performances to be hardware-dependent (see [url=https://store.steampowered.com/newshub/app/1287800/view/2944751149973128154]this previous announcement[/url]). Now the AI is standardized among machines and should offer a more consistent experience to all players.

[h2]Moveset tweaks[/h2]
[list]
[*] Random's moveset has been expanded to allow for more combo creativity.
[*] Wally's moveset has been reworked to address feedback about his zoning tools, in a way that makes him take more risks, but increasing his up-close reward.
[*] Small fixes to frame data for some characters.
[/list]

[h2]Open source engine upgraded[/h2]
[url=https://github.com/AndreaJens/SchwarzerblitzEngine]The source code of the engine[/url] on GitHub has been upgraded to reflect the current version (minus the Steam libraries due to licensing). Feel free to play with it if you are curious about what makes Schwarzerblitz "tick"!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37436603/7630f25757daa803187cfc3765183dad0e11124a.png[/img]

[h2]Is this all?[/h2]
For now, yes, but feel free to reach out to the [url=https://discord.gg/vXKrvpV]official Discord server[/url] in case of additional feedback and bug reports! And, as always, RIDE THE LIGHTNING!

notes.title: [IMPORTANT!] Schwarzerblitz v 1.2.7 - beta branch patch with major AI bug fix
notes.content:
This patch applies ONLY to the endless-beta branch of the game. To opt-in, right click on Schwarzerblitz in your Steam library, select Properties, Beta and use the password [b]mysteryjohnson [/b]to unlock it.
[b]This is the last beta update before the release of version 1.3 of the game[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37436603/041298147d2b487fdf849a77085e63bacad9ba62.png[/img]

[h1]Dear players, I apologize[/h1]
In the past four months, I have received wildly different reports about the game's difficulty. Some players found the difficulty pitiful, while some couldn't beat the arcade boss at Medium without summoning the help of eldritch fiends and asking for the intercession of the power that be. This wild swing was not only unexpected, but also concerning.
Furthermore, watching videos uploaded on YT by different players, I noticed that the difficulty seemed wildly inconsistent even when the difficulty settings were the same.

Well, I've finally found the culprit.

There was a nasty, hidden, vicious bug that made the game's difficulty dependent on the [b]frame rate of the PC the game was run on.[/b] This made the game a lot easier when played on high end PCs and much, much harder (borderline impossible) when played on lower-end PCs, causing the above differences.

I won't get into the technical details of the error (for those interested, a basic explanation can be found [url=https://twitter.com/AndreaDProjects/status/1318254240402427908?s=20]here, on my Twitter account[/url]), but suffices to say that what made the game impossible (or too easy) for you to play might have been a honest developer mistake.

I have fixed the bug and I will roll out the update to all branches at the end of the month. That said, you can already try the new version out in the endless-beta branch (password: [b]mysteryjohnson[/b]). I hope you will enjoy the change, but for any feedback do not hesitate to open a community hub!

notes.title: Schwarzerblitz v1.2.3 - Beta branch balance patch
notes.content:
This patch applies ONLY to the [b]endless-beta[/b] branch of the game. To opt-in, right click on Schwarzerblitz in your Steam library, select Properties, Beta and use the password [b]mysteryjohnson [/b]to unlock it.

[h2]v 1.2.3 (13.09.2020, beta branch)[/h2]
[h3]Bug fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] fixed a bug which caused the match to end improperly in story mode if a character was KOed by damage over time
[/list]
[h3]System changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Projectiles can now have accelerations and arced trajectories
[/list]
[h3]New content[/h3]
[b]Stages[/b]
[list]
[*] added the first version of "Parsec Arena" (music still to be replaced with the final version)
[*] added the first version of "After Hours" (music might be temporary)
[*] uploaded the improved version of Le Coq Heureux
[/list]
[b]Characters[/b]
[list]
[*] new costume: "Quarantine Rapport 2" Johnson
[*] new costume: "Unpaid Bills" Shaz (needs to be unlocked by completing arcade with him twice and clearing his trial)
[/list]
[h3]Character changes[/h3]
[b]Amy[/b]
[list]
[*] r.P: reduced active frames by 3 (the active time was not conform with the visual appearance of the move)
[/list]
[b]Elena[/b]
[list]
[*] c.3P: changed recovery stance after move to remove an unwanted animation jitter
[/list]
[b]Johnson[/b]
[list]
[*]Top Hat Doomsday (623 P) has been split into two different moves: 
[list]
[*]623 P (Top Hat Reprise) doesn't require Bullet Counters but does not launch. It can still be used as a juggling tool like the old Top Hat Doomsday, though. It's +12 on hit and deals 18 damage.
[*]623 P+K (Top Hat Doomsday) now costs one Bullet and it is equivalent to the previous iteration of Top Hat Doomsday. It deals 22 unscaled damage.
[/list]
[/list]
[b]Wally ([i]changes to Wally are still experimental and I'm using the beta to collect feedback[/i])[/b]
[list]
[*] Added 5 frames of recovery to his Brisbane Roundabout sidesteps
[*] Brisbane 2T: doesn't launch anymore, but causes pushback
[*] r.K: added Standing Launch properties
[*] Brisbane PP (Heavy Metal): changed into natural combo
[/list]
[b]Lazor[/b]
[list]
[*] Ultimate Diamond Crusher won't hit juggled or airborne opponents at full force. This prevents the One-Hit-KO variant of the move from being used during a juggle combo
[/list]
[b]Rattlebone[/b]
[list]
[*] changed move names to reflect the DoF naming convention
[*] updated intro and win quotes
[*] his axe moves have now proper acceleration and arcs
[*] his skull moves have been changed to make use of the acceleration
[/list]
